say:1:1841108001:1.text: I couldn't care less about being wanted by Bantus. I just never thought they'd accuse Rain and me of crimes we didn't commit.
say:1:1841108001:1.source_cn: 老身不在乎班题斯的通缉，只是没想到他们竟会把莫须有的罪...

say:1:1841108001:1.female: I couldn't care less about being wanted by Bantus. I just never thought they'd accuse Rain and me of crimes we didn't commit.

say:2:1841108002:0.text: Sabotage the Refinery? I've never done any such thing. Those fools at Bantus are barking up the wrong tree!
say:2:1841108002:0.source_cn: 破坏炼化间这种事，老身从未干过。班题斯那帮蠢材简直瞎了眼了！

say:4:1841108003:0.text: Bantus doesn't care who's guilty and who isn't. They decide who they want to arrest, then make up a reason afterward.
say:4:1841108003:0.source_cn: 班题斯抓人从不讲道理，更不在乎冤不冤枉。他们想抓谁便抓...

say:7:1841108005:0.text: I broke Rain out of the Refinery.
say:7:1841108005:0.source_cn: 便是将里纳从炼化间救出来之事。
say:7:1841108005:0.male: I broke Rain out of the Refinery.
say:7:1841108005:0.female: I broke Rain out of the Refinery.

say:8:1841108007:0.text: And I don't regret it. Not for a second.
say:8:1841108007:0.source_cn: 但这件事上，老身从未后悔过。
say:8:1841108007:0.male: And I don't regret it. Not for a second.
say:8:1841108007:0.female: And I don't regret it. Not for a second.

say:9:1841108008:0.text: Knowing Bantus, if I'd left him in there, there might've been no trace of him by the time I went back.
say:9:1841108008:0.source_cn: 以班题斯的手段，若是将里纳留在炼化间，说不准等老身下次...
say:9:1841108008:0.male: Knowing Bantus, if I'd left him in there, there might've been no trace of him by the time I went back.
say:9:1841108008:0.female: Knowing Bantus, if I'd left him in there, there might've been no trace of him by the time I went back.

say:10:1841108009:0.text: I couldn't take that chance. I wasn't going to stand by and let it happen.
say:10:1841108009:0.source_cn: 老身不能冒着这样大的风险，坐视不理。

say:12:1841108010:0.female: I've told you. I don't know myself.

say:13:1841108011:0.text: Maybe he seemed familiar. Or maybe I just couldn't stomach what Bantus was doing and felt sorry for him.
